mapper.select: SELECT bs.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, bs.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, bs.FSUBJECT_ID AS fsubjectId, bs.SUBJECT_LEVEL AS subjectLevel, bs.BAL_FLAG AS balFlag, bs.SUBJECT_TYPE AS subjectType FROM BOK_SUBJECT bs,BOK_BOOKSET bb WHERE bb.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND bs.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL

SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, A.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, A.FSUBJECT_NO AS fsubjectId, A.BAL_FLAG AS balFlagHappenDate, A.O_CCY AS oCcy, A.O_AMT AS balance, A.O_C_AMT AS cAmt, A.O_D_AMT AS dAmt, A.NUM_AMT AS num, A.IS_LEAF AS isLeaf, A.SUBJECT_LEVEL as subjectLevel, A.BALANCE_DATE balanceDate, A.SUBJECT_LEVEL subjectLevel, A.BAL_CO_FLAG balCoFlag, A.O_CO_AMT oCcyKnotsAmt, A.O_CO_C_AMT oCcyKnotsAmtC, A.O_CO_D_AMT oCcyKnotsAmtD, A.B_CCY bCcy, A.B_AMT bAmt, A.B_C_AMT bCAmt, A.B_CO_AMT bCoAmt, A.B_CO_C_AMT bCoCAmt, A.B_CO_D_AMT bCoDAmt, A.B_D_AMT bDAmt, 0 tdyOAmt, 0 tdyOCAmt, 0 tdyODAmt, 0 tdyOCoAmt, 0 tdyOCoCAmt, 0 tdyOCoDAmt, 0 tdyBAmt, 0 tdyBCAmt, 0 tdyBDAmt, 0 tdyBCoAmt, 0 tdyBCoCAmt, 0 tdyBCoDAmt, A.TDY_AMT_FLAG tdyAmtFlag, A.TDY_CO_FLAG tdyCoFlag, 0 tdyPurODUlamt, 0 tdyRedODUlamt, 0 tdyPurOCUlamt, 0 tdyRedOCUlamt, 0 tdyPurBDUlamt, 0 tdyRedBDUlamt, 0 tdyPurBCUlamt, 0 tdyRedBCUlamt, CASE WHEN A.SUBJECT_LEVEL = '99' THEN D.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE ELSE C.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE END as baseSubjectNature FROM BOK_BALANCE A LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON bb.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND C.SUBJECT_NO = A.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT D ON D.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND D.SUBJECT_NO = A.FSUBJECT_NO WHERE A.BALANCE_DATE = #{queryDate} AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, A.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, A.FSUBJECT_NO AS fsubjectId, A.BAL_FLAG AS balFlagHappenDate, A.O_CCY AS oCcy, A.O_AMT AS balance, A.O_C_AMT AS cAmt, A.O_D_AMT AS dAmt, A.NUM_AMT AS num, A.IS_LEAF AS isLeaf, A.SUBJECT_LEVEL as subjectLevel, A.BALANCE_DATE balanceDate, A.SUBJECT_LEVEL subjectLevel, A.BAL_CO_FLAG balCoFlag, A.O_CO_AMT oCcyKnotsAmt, A.O_CO_C_AMT oCcyKnotsAmtC, A.O_CO_D_AMT oCcyKnotsAmtD, A.B_CCY bCcy, A.B_AMT bAmt, A.B_C_AMT bCAmt, A.B_CO_AMT bCoAmt, A.B_CO_C_AMT bCoCAmt, A.B_CO_D_AMT bCoDAmt, A.B_D_AMT bDAmt, A.TDY_O_AMT tdyOAmt, A.TDY_O_C_AMT tdyOCAmt, A.TDY_O_D_AMT tdyODAmt, A.TDY_O_CO_AMT tdyOCoAmt, A.TDY_O_CO_C_AMT tdyOCoCAmt, A.TDY_O_CO_D_AMT tdyOCoDAmt, A.TDY_B_AMT tdyBAmt, A.TDY_B_C_AMT tdyBCAmt, A.TDY_B_D_AMT tdyBDAmt, A.TDY_B_CO_AMT tdyBCoAmt, A.TDY_B_CO_C_AMT tdyBCoCAmt, A.TDY_B_CO_D_AMT tdyBCoDAmt, A.TDY_AMT_FLAG tdyAmtFlag, A.TDY_CO_FLAG tdyCoFlag, A.TDY_PUR_O_D_ULAMT tdyPurODUlamt, A.TDY_PUR_O_C_ULAMT tdyPurOCUlamt, A.TDY_PUR_B_D_ULAMT tdyRedBDUlamt, A.TDY_PUR_B_C_ULAMT tdyRedBCUlamt,
A.TDY_RED_O_D_ULAMT tdyRedODUlamt, A.TDY_RED_O_C_ULAMT tdyRedOCUlamt, A.TDY_RED_B_D_ULAMT tdyPurBDUlamt, A.TDY_RED_B_C_ULAMT tdyPurBCUlamt,
CASE WHEN A.SUBJECT_LEVEL = '99' THEN D.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE ELSE C.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE END as baseSubjectNature
FROM BOK_BALANCE A LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON bb.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND C.SUBJECT_NO = A.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT D ON D.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND D.SUBJECT_NO = A.FSUBJECT_NO WHERE A.IS_LEAF ='Y' AND A.BALANCE_DATE = #{queryDate} AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
